requirements: The system shall let employees and administrators add a product with all required fields.
The system shall let employees and administrators search, filter, and view product records including internal costs.
The system shall show customers only active products and public specifications, selling price, and availability.
The system shall let employees and administrators update product fields while retaining the product ID.
The system shall show removal eligibility and require explicit confirmation before deletion or inactivation.
The system shall display field-specific errors and retain entered values when validation fails.
The final system shall enforce role permissions on every protected page and action.
rules: All product input fields shown in the product form are required.
Finished inventory must be a nonnegative whole number measured in pairs.
Customers may view only active products.
Customers must not have access to manufacturing cost.
A product with historical transactions must be inactivated instead of permanently deleted.
A product with material requirements must not be permanently deleted.
A product with neither material requirements nor historical transactions may be deleted after confirmation.
A current selling-price change must not change prices stored on historical order lines.
acceptance: Given a complete valid product, when Add product is selected, then the prototype assigns a unique ID and shows the new product in this tab.
Given missing fields, negative amounts, or fractional stock, when submitted, then the form retains values and identifies each invalid field.
Given sample products, when name/ID, type, or status filters change, then the list and result count reflect all selected filters.
Given an existing product, when View is selected, then all product fields including internal cost are displayed in the staff preview.
Given active and inactive products, when the customer catalog opens, then only active products and public fields appear; no cost or employee fields appear in the page.
Given an existing product, when a valid edit is saved, then changed values appear under the same product ID.
Given P1002 with no dependencies, when Confirm delete is selected, then the record disappears from this tab and a confirmation is shown.
Given a removal page or an edited form, when Cancel is selected, then the stored sample record is unchanged.
Given P1001 with historical transactions, when removal is reviewed, then permanent deletion is unavailable and Confirm mark inactive preserves the record.
Given P1003 with material requirements, when removal is reviewed, then deletion is unavailable and an explanation is shown.
Given a search with no matches, when the list updates, then a no-results explanation and clear-filters action appear.
Given an order-line price in the final database, when current selling price changes, then the historical value remains unchanged. Design-only at midterm.
Given a customer requests a protected URL in the final system, when authorization is checked on the server, then access is denied. Deferred; not implemented by the prototype.
Given zero price, zero cost, and zero pairs, when all other fields are valid, then the product is accepted.
